notes.title: Update 1.1.2
notes.content:
Patch Notes:
-Added crafting bench and new crafting system.
-Fixed pickup/hold UI.
-Fixed death inventory doubles.
-Fixed close container/bench when moving.
-Fixed NPC dialogues.
-Added NPC characters.
-Added NPC voices.
-Added new crafting items.
-Added new crafting recipes.
-Improved door rotation. For now only red gates, still testing. (Reported by dergillz)
-Fixed game still running after exiting the game.
-Added human character menu/create.
-Removed random inventory items spawn.
-Fixed HUD bug not showing items info.
-Fixed inventory/building save.
-Fixed and Added new building system.
-Fixed FPS bug. Tick Issue.
-Fixed roads floating in the air.
-Removed stones from the road.

notes.title: Update 1.1.1
notes.content:
Patch Notes:
-Fixed coop search. (Reported by ᵃ)
-Added new enemy system with animations, sounds and sync.
-Fixed cow collision and animation.
-Fixed and added new POI.
-Fixed player jump animation.
-Fixed moving physics when standing on objects.
-Added new gun system, with animations, sounds and sync.
-Fixed player hand animations.
-Added death system. (For players, enemy and animals)
-Fixed train bogies.
-Fixed main menu buttons grey bug.
-Added controls menu. (Reported by ROC13 and minho8012)
-Added inverted mouse option. (Reported by CyborgSmurf)
-Fixed display menu resolution option bug. (Reported by minho8012)
-Fixed LODs to improve fps.
-Fixed sit animation in car.
-Moved project to new engine version.
-Added niagra particles to gun shots.
-Fixed lag when streaming new map.
-Added new character movement system.
-Added ocean, drivable boat and swimming with animations, sound and sync.
-Fixed main hand weapon showing when entering drivers sit.
-Made map chunks smaller to improve fps.
-Added alien like walls so you don't go out of bounds.
-Fixed many more bugs.
